title: UW IRS Verification of Non-filing Letter Procedure

steps.label: Choose Request Method
steps.description_plain: Request letter from IRS via Online, Telephone, or Paper form.
steps.source_sentence: Non Tax filers can request an IRS Verification of Non-filing Letter, free of charge, from the IRS in one of three ways:

steps.label: Submit Online Request
steps.description_plain: Access IRS Get Transcript Online tool.
documents: Account number for loan or credit card
steps.source_sentence: Follow instructions for creating an account or log in.

steps.label: Select Non-Filing Letter & Tax Year
steps.description_plain: Specify the requested tax year for verification.
steps.source_sentence: Select “Verification of Non-filing Letter” and in the Tax Year field, enter the tax year we are requesting.

steps.label: Submit Letter to Financial Aid Office
steps.description_plain: Submit printed letter with student name and ID.
steps.source_sentence: Submit the IRS Verification of Non-filing Letter, if requested, to the Office of Student Financial Aid; make sure to include the student’s name and UW student ID number on the letter.

steps.label: Request Letter by Telephone
steps.description_plain: Call IRS automated phone service to order paper letter.

deadline.text: within 5 to 10 days from the time of the request

steps.source_sentence: Available from the IRS by calling 1-800-908-9946.

steps.label: Download & Complete Form 4506-T
steps.description_plain: Download IRS Form 4506-T and complete lines 1 through 9.

steps.label: Mail or Fax Form 4506-T
steps.description_plain: Send completed form to the IRS processing address or fax.
steps.source_sentence: Mail or fax the completed IRS Form 4506-T to the address (or FAX number) provided on page 2 of Form 4506-T.

gaps.description: Procedure if student or parent filed a Puerto Rican or foreign income tax return
Procedure if online identity verification fails or user has no mobile phone
